purpose: 展示多发送者、多位置及同位置双失败的完整顺序，并显示 Pedersen 拒绝与 Feldman ValueError 的既有聚合结果。
output:
INPUT damage: sender 1 receiver 1 secret share + sender 1 receiver 3 blinding share
INPUT damage: sender 2 Feldman commitment replaced by sender 1 commitment
INPUT damage: sender 3 receiver 1 blinding share
PASS complete canonical diagnosis: (ContributionFault(sender_id=1, receiver_id=1, check='pedersen'), ContributionFault(sender_id=1, receiver_id=1, check='feldman'), ContributionFault(sender_id=1, receiver_id=3, check='pedersen'), ContributionFault(sender_id=2, receiver_id=1, check='feldman'), ContributionFault(sender_id=2, receiver_id=2, check='feldman'), ContributionFault(sender_id=2, receiver_id=3, check='feldman'), ContributionFault(sender_id=3, receiver_id=1, check='pedersen'))
CALL diagnose_signing_contributions(mixed) -> (ContributionFault(sender_id=1, receiver_id=1, check='pedersen'), ContributionFault(sender_id=1, receiver_id=1, check='feldman'), ContributionFault(sender_id=1, receiver_id=3, check='pedersen'), ContributionFault(sender_id=2, receiver_id=1, check='feldman'), ContributionFault(sender_id=2, receiver_id=2, check='feldman'), ContributionFault(sender_id=2, receiver_id=3, check='feldman'), ContributionFault(sender_id=3, receiver_id=1, check='pedersen'))
